policies.name: Material Teacher v1 / Normal
policies.description: Sampled-world three-ply material teacher with bounded mission corrections.

policies.name: Rollout Teacher v1 / Normal
policies.description: Sampled-world, masked-policy four-ply rollout teacher; validated desktop reference.

policies.name: Priorities v1 / Normal
policies.description: Classic lexicographic priorities: win, confirmed flag defense, safe disclosed capture, escape, cooperation, safe objective progress, then remaining moves. Existing scores rank moves within each class.

policies.name: Reconsidered Plans v2 / Normal
policies.description: Public job/actor identity and best-route progress persist; eight unproductive decisions cool a sector for sixteen decisions and permit Scout-led investigation of other rear blockers. Fixes the initial uncompiled registration.

policies.name: Context Rollout Teacher v1 / Normal
policies.description: Eight-world four-ply masked rollout using the guarded student, retaining public root goals, quiet history and piece identities; simulated public events update memory.

policies.name: Context Student v2 / Normal
policies.description: One 31-node full/cold-history fit from the public context-preserving rollout teacher; retains assigned-actor cooperation guard. Distinct from the older inventory-feature Context Student v1.

policies.name: Cold Context Control v1 / Normal
policies.description: Same guarded-student rollout and public simulated memory as Context Teacher v1, with root strategic-state transfer disabled. Diagnostic ablation only.

policies.name: Guarded Student Diagnostic v1 / Normal
policies.description: Production move policy with forced-history diagnostic acknowledgments; no strategic change. Used only to compare identical permitted histories.

policies.name: Linked Scouting v1 / Normal
policies.description: Scout information credit requires another friendly piece with a legal attack whose value changes after disclosure. Uses only public inventories and movement; replaces blanket Scout probe credit and guides Scout objectives.

policies.name: Reply-Aware Teacher v1 / Normal
policies.description: Context teacher with up to three first opponent replies selected and weighted from that mover's masked-policy scores; same eight worlds, four plies, guarded-student futures and bounded correction blend.

policies.name: Ranking Student v1 / Normal
policies.description: Rejected offline: one 64-tree additive pairwise ranking fit; shortlisted training did not constrain all legal actions. Preserved for diagnosis, not an upgrade.

policies.name: Ranking Student v2 / Normal
policies.description: Rejected offline: all-legal-action pairwise coverage repair, same 64-tree additive desktop model. Did not improve mean training choice regret; original heldout now development only.

policies.name: MS-DOS Stratego 1990 v1 / Colonel
policies.description: Original 16-bit AI, Colonel difficulty3, headless Unicorn execution. Original privileged physical-rank knowledge retained; fixed Classic referee and Scout move/attack enabled. Original setup UI and automatic no-move mode switching omitted.
policies.information_model: Original physical-rank access, including hidden Flag/Spy and other original disclosure paths. Opponent initial army supplied only to this reference adapter.

policies.name: MS-DOS Stratego 1990 v2 / Colonel (fast)
policies.description: Original 1990 16-bit AI with fast native-block JIT execution and per-call watchdog. Colonel3; original hidden-rank knowledge retained, Classic referee, common deployments. Exact state/choice parity with v1 checked; not full DOS UI emulation.
policies.information_model: Original physical-rank access, including hidden Flag/Spy and other original disclosure paths. Opponent initial army supplied only to this reference adapter.

policies.name: DIAGNOSTIC Context Teacher v1 / all enemy ranks
policies.description: Diagnostic information ablation of Context Teacher v1; all surviving enemy ranks known. Never intended for production or ordinary play.
policies.information_model: diagnostic-full-enemy-ranks
policies.model: Unchanged guarded-student production model and bounded rollout correction; information intervention only.

policies.name: DIAGNOSTIC Context Teacher v1 / Flag and Spy only
policies.description: Diagnostic information ablation of Context Teacher v1; only enemy Flag and Spy identities known in addition to public information. Never intended for production or ordinary play.
policies.information_model: diagnostic-flag-spy
policies.model: Unchanged guarded-student production model and bounded rollout correction; information intervention only.

policies.name: Information Lifetime Teacher v1 / Normal
policies.description: Bounded costs for Scouts/Sergeants initiating known losing attacks or newly entering disclosed lethal reach. Preserve their opportunity for a later new disclosure; no reward merely for sacrificing. Other tactical value can override the cost.
policies.model: Unchanged guarded-student production correction model and Context Teacher v1; public-root information strategy only.
policies.information_model: public masked ranks and event history only

policies.name: Flag Corridor Recon Teacher v1 / Normal
policies.description: Route expendable Scouts/Sergeants/Lieutenants to uncertain Flag-region screens supported by an accessible combat unit/Miner. Uses public candidate masks and weak positional priors, not true Flag position.
policies.model: Unchanged guarded-student production correction model and Context Teacher v1; public-root information strategy only.
policies.information_model: public masked ranks and event history only

policies.name: Response-Aware Probe Teacher v1 / Normal
policies.description: Charge expendable hidden-target attacks an information-opportunity budget. Credit only conditional attack/abstention decisions robust to one enemy response, including escape, loss of beneficiary, recapture, and terminal Flag loss.
policies.model: Unchanged guarded-student production correction model and Context Teacher v1; public-root information strategy only.
policies.information_model: public masked ranks and event history only

policies.name: Calibrated Public-History Belief Teacher v1 / Normal
policies.description: Infer enemy ranks more accurately from public movement history and deployment geometry, replacing the teacher's hand-written approach/retreat multiplier. No reconnaissance score bonuses or search changes.
policies.information_model: Own army and public history only; learned hidden-rank likelihoods, exact public inventory.
policies.model: Frozen categorical belief tables plus unchanged Context Teacher v1 guarded student.

policies.name: Probability Control Teacher v1 / Normal
policies.description: A short rollout can favor actions that exploit its simulated opponent rather than the real opponent. Restricting the search-induced change in move probabilities toward the native move policy may generalize better. probability-control
policies.model: Unchanged Context Teacher v1 guarded student and eight-world masked sampler; frozen native-score root-selection settings.
policies.information_model: Own army and public history only; no diagnostic truth, learned beliefs or information bonuses.

policies.name: KL Restrained Search Teacher v1 / Normal
policies.description: A short rollout can favor actions that exploit its simulated opponent rather than the real opponent. Restricting the search-induced change in move probabilities toward the native move policy may generalize better. kl-restrained
policies.model: Unchanged Context Teacher v1 guarded student and eight-world masked sampler; frozen native-score root-selection settings.
policies.information_model: Own army and public history only; no diagnostic truth, learned beliefs or information bonuses.

policies.name: DIAGNOSTIC Flag-only Context Teacher v1 / Normal
policies.description: Privileged-information ablation: identify only enemy Flag, leaving Spy and every other concealed rank masked. Original Context Teacher search unchanged.
policies.information_model: diagnostic-flag
policies.model: Unchanged Context Teacher v1 guarded student, eight worlds and four-ply masked continuation; Flag-only disclosure intervention.

policies.name: teacher-context-worlds32-v1-normal
policies.description: Honest 32-world sampling-budget ablation of teacher-context-v1-normal
policies.model: Unchanged four-ply guarded Context Teacher; 32 independent public-compatible armies.

policies.name: teacher-calibrated-worlds32-v1-normal
policies.description: Honest 32-world sampling-budget ablation of teacher-calibrated-beliefs-v1-normal
policies.information_model: Own army and public history only; learned hidden-rank likelihoods, exact public inventory.
policies.model: Unchanged four-ply guarded Context Teacher; 32 independent public-compatible armies.

policies.name: teacher-latin-worlds-v1-normal
policies.description: Latin-hypercube random coordinates spread eight count-consistent worlds without additional native searches.
policies.model: Unchanged eight-world four-ply Context Teacher plus isolated teacher-latin-worlds-v1-normal
policies.information_model: Own setup and public events only. No opponent setup or diagnostic disclosure.

policies.name: teacher-army-activation-v1-normal
policies.description: Bounded quiet-move potential rewards opening teammates routes to central crossings; enemy ranks unused.
policies.model: Unchanged eight-world four-ply Context Teacher plus isolated teacher-army-activation-v1-normal
policies.information_model: Own setup and public events only. No opponent setup or diagnostic disclosure.

policies.name: teacher-paired-confidence-v1-normal
policies.description: Require paired corrected advantage over native move to exceed one jackknife standard error; no extra rollouts.
policies.model: Unchanged eight-world four-ply Context Teacher plus isolated teacher-paired-confidence-v1-normal
policies.information_model: Own setup and public events only. No opponent setup or diagnostic disclosure.

policies.name: teacher-capture-quiescence-v1-normal
policies.description: Finish policy-selected exchanges beyond four plies, stopping before a quiet move, with at most four extra masked decisions.
policies.model: Isolated honest Context Teacher experiment: teacher-capture-quiescence-v1-normal
policies.information_model: Own setup and public events only; sampled worlds never referee ranks.

policies.name: teacher-sparse-depth-v1-normal
policies.description: Spend eight plies only when public root mobility has at most twelve legal actions, retaining four otherwise.
policies.model: Isolated honest Context Teacher experiment: teacher-sparse-depth-v1-normal
policies.information_model: Own setup and public events only; sampled worlds never referee ranks.

policies.name: teacher-recurrence-escape-v1-normal
policies.description: Remember repeated friendly formations across actors and escape long quiet loops when a similarly valued fresh continuation exists.
policies.model: Isolated honest Context Teacher experiment: teacher-recurrence-escape-v1-normal
policies.information_model: Own setup and public events only; sampled worlds never referee ranks.

policies.name: teacher-uniform-worlds-v1-normal
policies.description: Ablate handwritten approach/retreat weights while retaining exactly the same IID count-consistent world proposal; negative-control belief test.
policies.model: Isolated honest Context Teacher experiment: teacher-uniform-worlds-v1-normal
policies.information_model: Own setup and public events only; sampled worlds never referee ranks.
